landing.heroBadge: Government School Child Safety & Digital Gate Entry System
landing.heroSubtitle: GateSathi — School ka digital register. Sign in below, download the standalone web app directly from Chrome or any browser, and run 100% of your school gate & admin operations inside the app.
landing.loggedInWelcome: You are signed in! Download the standalone web app below or jump straight into your workspace.
landing.loginCardDesc: Sign in as Principal / Admin or Security Guard. Right after signing in, you can download the app from Chrome or any browser.
landing.adminHint: Principal & Super Admin: Bulk student/guardian CSV & Excel import, guardian approvals, and school oversight.
landing.guardHint: Security Guard: 10-digit phone lookup, OTP verification, live camera photo, entry & exit tracking.
landing.postLoginNote: Once logged in, click 'Download App' to install GateSathi on your phone or desktop and work 100% inside it.
landing.featuresTitle: Every Function of the GateSathi Web App
landing.featuresSubtitle: Purpose-built for Indian government schools — from fast 3G gate operations on low-end Android phones to bulk principal administration.
landing.f1Desc: Enter a 10-digit mobile number to immediately load known visitor profiles and their linked students (including siblings) for 1-tap selection, or search any active student by name, admission number, or class.
landing.f2Title: 2. First-Time Visitor OTP & Bilingual DPDP Consent
landing.f2Desc: Verifies first-time visitors via 6-digit SMS OTP (5-minute expiry, rate-limited per hour) and records bilingual Hindi & English Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) consent.
landing.f3Title: 3. Live Rear-Camera Capture & Private R2 Cloud Storage
landing.f3Desc: Captures live visitor photos from the rear camera, compresses in-browser to ~150 KB JPEG, uploads via presigned Cloudflare R2 URLs, and verifies size & school prefix on the server.
landing.f4Title: 4. Guardian Approval Check & Child Pickup Protection
landing.f4Desc: Server-side verification ensures the visitor is an approved guardian for every selected student. Unapproved visitors require structured reason chips and a mandatory second confirmation before pickup.
landing.f5Title: 5. Live 'Inside Campus Now' Monitor & 17:05 IST Auto-Close
landing.f5Desc: Real-time dashboard of visitors currently inside campus with 1-tap exit marking, 'Left with student' tracking, and a scheduled Netlify cron job that auto-closes open visits at 17:05 IST daily.
landing.f6Desc: Bulk import up to 5,000 students and guardians (.csv/.xlsx) with Hindi & English column mapping, automatic sibling guardian linking, conflict safety without overwriting names, and downloadable CSV reports.
landing.f7Title: 7. Enterprise Security, School-Scoped RBAC & Audit Logs
landing.f7Desc: Strict school isolation across Guard, Principal, and Super Admin roles, persistent MongoDB rate limiting, 5-minute session revocation, and immutable AuditLog records.
landing.workflowTitle: How to Login, Download & Work 100% on the App
landing.step1Title: Step 1: Sign In on This Website
landing.step1Desc: Use the Admin or Security Guard login box on this page with your registered 10-digit mobile number and password.
landing.step2Title: Step 2: Download from Chrome or Any Browser
landing.step2Desc: Click the 'Download App' button in the top bar or hero section to install GateSathi onto your phone or desktop.
landing.step3Title: Step 3: Work 100% Inside the Downloaded App
landing.step3Desc: Launch GateSathi directly from your home screen or desktop app icon in full standalone mode with fast asset caching.
landing.footerTagline: Built for safe, accountable student entry & exit across Indian schools.
